Composition-specific record for the Fe-bearing 5K2681 specimen. The article establishes Pbnm, Z=4 and the stored 1.7 GPa lattice for this sample, but the official deposit contains positional refinements only for the Fe-free crystal. The stored coordinates and ideal NaAlSiO4 occupancies are therefore an isostructural topology proxy from the official 1.7 GPa Fe-free CIF, not an exact refinement or an inferred Fe/Al/Si distribution for 5K2681. The proxy intentionally does not claim to reproduce Fe scattering or the analytical non-stoichiometry. The article reports 90% of the iron as ferric from Wu et al. (2017), but site-specific Fe occupancies are not given and are not inferred.

Standard third-order Birch-Murnaghan pressure-volume EOS in the Eulerian finite-strain convention at room temperature. V0, K0, and K0\_prime were all fitted with EosFit7c; none was fixed. Parenthesized coefficient errors are retained as generic published uncertainties because the source gives neither confidence level nor covariance. The observed range is not a phase-stability guarantee. See docs/qin-2023-naalsio4-eos.md.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.
